Initial release of Firehose API Skill.

- Provides concise documentation for managing taps, rules, and real-time streams via Firehose API.
- Details endpoints for creating, listing, updating, and revoking taps and rules.
- Includes authentication guidance for both management keys and tap tokens.
- Documents Server-Sent Events (SSE) streaming, event types, and reconnection strategies.
- Outlines Lucene query syntax and indexed fields for real-time web monitoring.
